name: Fail2Ban_AbuseIPDB
notes: v1.4.0: two-way leader/follower sync - followers receive the bans they are missing (applied through fail2ban-client) and the addresses the cluster already reported, so no address is ever reported twice; includes v1.3.x: optional coordination for one shared account (abuseipdb-coord, --coord-status), status.json and Prometheus metrics, Retry-After and adaptive backoff, UTC budget day, classifier registry.
